releaseNotes:
- Shared Plex Server Seerr Authentication Fix: Fixed Seerr /api/v1/auth/plex failing (HTTP 500) on shared Plex servers by authenticating with the user's plex.tv account token first and falling back to the server token.
- Seerr Session & Proxy Reliability: Added in-flight authentication deduplication so opening Requests authenticates once instead of firing duplicate requests, and improved Set-Cookie parsing for reverse proxies that prepend extra cookies.
- App Version Bump: v1.11.2 (versionCode 61)
